_comment: Competitor price sources (EDGE data, not core code). Per-SKU product-page URLs — deterministic, low-volume, no search scraping. The fetcher honours robots.txt, rate-limits, validates the page matches OUR product (brand + MPN/title tokens) before recording, and labels provenance jsonld:<domain>. Fill product_urls with the pages you'd open in a browser; leave enabled=false until then.
